intro.description: I am a computer science student with a passion for Java programming. I specialize in creating applications that are not only efficient but also secure. I continuously develop my skills and eagerly take on new challenges to become better at what I do.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: Hi! I am a 22-year-old Computer Science student at the Wyższa Szkoła Zarządzania i Bankowości in Krakow, planning to complete my engineering studies in 2026. I am passionate about software development in Java. My goal is to design applications that are not only efficient but also secure and scalable.
about.p2: I have experience gained through my own projects, as well as developing my skills in cybersecurity. I believe that every application should be designed with user safety and optimal performance in mind, which forms the basis of my work.
about.p3: My approach to programming is based on a continuous pursuit of excellence. I love solving complex technical problems and seeking innovative solutions that bring real benefits to users. I can work both independently and in a team, allowing me to fully utilize my skills in various projects.

carRental.title: Mobile Car Rental Application
carRental.desc: Mobile application enabling car rentals, user management, and online payments.

carRentalBackend.title: Mobile Car Rental Application Backend
carRentalBackend.desc: Client-server backend managing business logic, database, and user security.

hashAlgorithm.title: Hash Algorithm with Nonce
hashAlgorithm.desc: Generating transactions and searching for a nonce to obtain a hash ending with five zeros.

terminalStore.title: Terminal Store
terminalStore.desc: Console application with user registration, shopping cart, and order processing using a database.

concurrentJava.title: Concurrent Programming in Java
concurrentJava.desc: System solving thread synchronization problems using semaphores and blocking mechanisms.

advancedCollections.title: Advanced Collection Operations
advancedCollections.desc: Processing large datasets using streams and aggregation functions.

readersWriters.title: Readers and Writers Problem in Java
readersWriters.desc: Implementation of the classic thread synchronization problem using semaphores and condition variables. The system allows multiple readers to access simultaneously and single writers, preventing deadlocks.

producerConsumer.title: Producer-Consumer Problem in Java
producerConsumer.desc: Implementation of the classic thread synchronization problem using monitors and conditional waiting. The system ensures proper data exchange between producers and consumers, preventing collisions and deadlocks.

restApiBuilder.title: Spring Boot – REST API for People (Builder Pattern)
restApiBuilder.desc: Creating a simple REST API for managing a list of people. The project demonstrates the use of the Builder pattern for object creation and unit testing using Spring Test and Mockito.

concurrentDataStructures.title: Advanced Concurrent Data Structures
concurrentDataStructures.desc: Implementation of concurrent lists with fine-grained node locking and performance tests in a multithreaded environment. Comparison of the efficiency between a single global lock and fine-grained locking.

fivePhilosophers.title: Concurrent Performance Testing – Dining Philosophers Problem
fivePhilosophers.desc: Implementation of the classic Dining Philosophers problem using various synchronization mechanisms in Java: synchronized, semaphores, ReentrantLock, and waiter. Analysis of the selected approach’s impact on concurrency performance and safety.

patientRegistration.title: Patient Registration System for Medical Examination
patientRegistration.desc: Application that allows patient registration for medical examinations. Includes a form for entering patient data and endpoints to display patients registered for a given appointment.

robotIoC.title: Robot Using IoC (Inversion of Control)
robotIoC.desc: Program controlling a robot using IoC in Spring. It consists of the main `Robot` class, which interacts with components such as `MotionSensor` and `MainMotor`. The program allows robot control and obstacle detection.

dockerDevOps.title: Docker + DevOps + IaC (Flask + Nginx + PostgreSQL)
dockerDevOps.desc: Web environment in Docker with Flask, Nginx, and PostgreSQL, multi-stage Dockerfile, database seeding, Pytest tests, and CI/CD in GitHub Actions. Azure used for minimal IaC setup.

voiceCommands.title: Voice Command Recognition
voiceCommands.desc: Using a neural network (CNN) to recognize voice commands based on MFCC features.

chessGenetic.title: Chess with Genetic Algorithm
chessGenetic.desc: Chess game using the MiniMax algorithm and material weight optimization with a genetic algorithm (DEAP).

spaceInvaders.title: Space Invaders
spaceInvaders.desc: Classic "Space Invaders" game built with JavaScript and Three.js. The game features different difficulty levels, camera switching, and automatic shooting.
